title: Guardianship: The Summons
summary: On Monday, March 2, 2015, Montgomery County Deputy Miller politely serves Jordan in Kelsey Brennan's office with a Norfolk Circuit Court Petition for Adult Guardianship filed by his mother. That evening at The Hotel at Poly, attorney Arthur Miller convenes a War Council showing how Jordan's independent insurance, tax return, power chair, and CABG surgical consent will dismantle the petition in court.

scenes.title: The War Council and the Hotel at Poly
